title: OperatingMode
description: Declaration of a repository's execution mode. Lives at .pipe/mode.json in the repository root. Absent or invalid file means restricted. Agents must never create or modify this file; mode changes are human-only actions. Contract: execution/operating-modes.md.

mode.description: exploration: agents run the ticket/PR/merge/non-production-deploy loop autonomously. restricted: human approval per execution/approval-gates.md.

reason.description: Why this mode is appropriate now, e.g. pre-production discovery vs live application.

activatedBy.description: Human who activated this mode. Must be a person, not an agent.

notes.description: Optional constraints or context, e.g. named exceptions already approved elsewhere.

examples.reason: Pre-production discovery; no real users or customer data.
Application is live in production with real users.
examples.notes: Return to exploration only for isolated spike branches approved per ticket.
